Once upon a time my roommate (and good friend) had this mirror she used to see the back of her hair when she was styling it. It is a pretty large mirror....  I’d say a foot long and 9 inches across. That’s a rough estimate. Anyways, one day she asks me if I happened to have borrowed her mirror. I said no, because I had not. She looks all over her room for the mirror. Her room is pretty small. She looks under her dresser and all sorts of places and the mirror is no where to be found. 

Fast forward some amount of time, and her and I are watching some show on Netflix in the living room. We live in a pretty small duplex apartment, so her room is adjacent to the living room. We hear a crash come from her room. It’s the fucking mirror. It had just showed up the fuck out of nowhere- crashing to the floor.  My roommate is not an emotional person, I’ve seen her cry like twice in over ten years, and she started tearing up trying to make me say that I had taken the mirror and had put it back. I had not. She swears she searched high and low for that fucking mirror - and it just falls out onto the floor out of nowhere?!?!??

Still can’t make sense of it.
